model_transparency_title: Data Provenance, Model Validation & Scientific Methodology
model_arch_desc: National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting (NCMRWF) and IMD operational criteria. Hybrid Physics-Informed Random Forest Classifier coupled with tropical climate drivers (ENSO Niño 3.4, BOM IOD, CPC MJO).
model_eval_desc: Evaluated using chronological train/test partitioning (Train: 2023–2024, Test: 2025) to prevent temporal data leakage. Demonstrated positive Brier Skill Score (+0.158) over climatological baseline.

onset_methodology_note: IMD's operational onset criteria are defined for declaration of southwest monsoon onset over Kerala and its advance. VarshaSetu uses these meteorological indicators as reference features within its hyperlocal probabilistic assessment; this dashboard does not represent an official IMD onset declaration.
